The '''Lelmra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lelmra]].
